Tagline: A little more love for your lips.
Mission: Create lip colour and care products that make everyday beauty feel easy, expressive and enjoyable.
Vision: Build a lip-first beauty world where colour, care, flavour and texture belong in the same routine.
Brand Story: Velorié began with a simple idea: the lip products people reach for most should feel as good as they look. The fictional brand blends playful colour, sensory flavours and thoughtful cosmetic ingredients into easy rituals for everyday life.
Brand Personality: Playful, polished, warm, curious, modern, sensory
Brand Values: Ease; expression; thoughtful formulas; sensory pleasure; everyday confidence; clear communication
Brand Positioning: A modern lip-first beauty brand combining wearable colour, enjoyable flavours, appealing textures and cosmetic care cues.
Brand Promise: Make every lip step feel easy to reach for and lovely to use.
Target Market: Young adults and beauty shoppers who enjoy lip colour, lip care and sensory beauty rituals.
Geographic Market: India-first fictional market with urban and digitally engaged consumers
Price Positioning: Accessible to mid-premium, with selected premium ritual products
Brand Aesthetic: Modern editorial beauty softened by playful fruit, dessert and botanical cues.
Visual Identity Description: Clean typography, glossy product close-ups, soft editorial compositions, tactile textures and controlled colour accents.
Preferred Colour Palette: Cream #F7F1E8; Berry #7A284B; Cherry #B52E46; Peach #E9A06D; Cocoa #6B4637; Soft Rose #D8A3AE; Leaf #65745A
Photography Style: Natural light, macro texture, reflective surfaces, fruit or ingredient props, lived-in beauty routines and uncluttered editorial styling.
Packaging Style: Compact, tactile packaging with rounded forms, restrained typography, flavour-coded accents and a consistent cap or closure system.
Brand Vocabulary: glaze; veil; melt; cloud; velvet; glaze; glow; cushion; swipe; ritual; wash; tint; plush; fresh
Words the Brand Commonly Uses: soft; glossy; juicy; creamy; sheer; satin; polished; everyday; ritual; layer; swipe; melt
Words the Brand Should Avoid: miracle; cure; heal; clinically proven; detox; toxin-free; guaranteed; perfect; flawless; anti-aging
Brand Voice: Warm, sensory, clear and lightly witty.
Tone Characteristics: Friendly, polished, descriptive, playful without sounding childish, informative without sounding clinical.
Communication Style: Short vivid sentences, concrete sensory language, useful product guidance and clear cosmetic claims.
Key Selling Themes: Wearable colour; sensory flavours; appealing textures; easy routines; ingredient stories; layering; portability; ritual
Core Product Philosophy: Make lip colour and care easy to understand, pleasant to use and easy to fit into real routines.
Ingredient Philosophy: Use familiar cosmetic ingredients and explain their cosmetic role plainly without fear-based language or unsupported claims.
Flavour Philosophy: Use recognisable flavours plus a few unexpected pairings to make products memorable without making the brand childish.
Shade Philosophy: Build wearable families across nudes, pinks, berries, reds, peaches and transparent effects, with different finishes.
Sustainability Positioning: Use restrained packaging, minimise unnecessary secondary materials where practical and communicate only verified sustainability details.
General Content Strategy: Balance education, product discovery, sensory storytelling, routines, community and promotion while rotating personas and formats.
